title: Analyses across diagnoses and settings of polypharmacy in inpatient mental healthcare.
summary: The project analyses routine data of inpatients and day patients of nine psychiatric hospitals of the Rhineland Regional Council  in Germany. The association covers 4.4 million inhabitants of the Rhineland. The routine data are updated on a daily basis and made available for purposes of quality control and scientific studies in an anonymized statistics database. Polypharmacy is defined as the use of at least three drugs. The project is designed to gain insights into the patient groups with polypharmacy and potential interventions aimed at reducing the polypharmacy rate.  By scientific publications, other providers of mental healthcare may be sensitized for this issue and may be informed about interventions.

interventions.name: Retrospective Analysis of all psychiatric inpatients and day patients of the LVR Clinics Association hospitals of the years 2023-2025, extended to 2026 if feasible.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Alle inpatient and daypatient cases of the sections of General Psychiatry, gerontopsychiatry and addiction disorders of the years 2023-2025 with possible extension to include 2026 in the course of the project.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients can object to the use of routine data for research purposes according to Para 21 of the German data protection regulations.
